subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a unified core contract that persists router-selected model identity and provider-billed per-turn cost and automatically displays both in response footers?
rationale: The choice affects transport metadata, session persistence, agent introspection, cost provenance, and user-visible footer policy; code inspection cannot determine the intended permanent product contract.

options.title: Defer until sponsored
options.body: Close this combined request for now while the two narrower open issues retain the model-identity and cost-contract discussions.

options.title: Sponsor unified metadata
options.body: Reopen or retain this issue as the canonical project for provider-neutral routed-model and billed-cost metadata plus footer presentation.

options.title: Limit to footer display
options.body: Approve a narrow OpenRouter-only footer suffix without establishing reusable session and agent metadata.

recommendation.title: Defer until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this combined request for now while the two narrower open issues retain the model-identity and cost-contract discussions.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available history across the OpenAI-compatible transport, OpenRouter integration, and usage-cost presentation paths needed for the product choice.
